subject.name: History
subject.programme: IB DP History SL/HL – NEW guide (first teaching Aug 2026, first exam May 2028)
subject.examPattern: IB DP – graded 1–7; recommended 150 h SL / 240 h HL; exams May (Hindi May only). NEW guide HL: Paper 1 source analysis 1 h 15, 24 marks, 3 questions on 3 sources (20%); Paper 2 concept & thematic essays 1 h 45, 25 marks (1 of 2 + 1 of 2) (25%); Paper 3 HL regional 2 h, 30 marks, 2 essays (35%); IA 24 marks (20%). Partly UNVERIFIED (secondary sources).

subtopics.name: The six key concepts: change, continuity, causation, consequence, significance and perspectives
